title.en: Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains (Master Wuyong Scroll)

museum_text.zh: 黃公望（西元一二六九－一三五四年），富陽人。字子久，號一峰，又號大癡道人，晚號井西道人。山水以董源為宗，為元四大家之冠。 此卷為僧無用所作，於至正七年（一三四七）起草，其年正八十歲。得暇即畫數筆，其中因曾外出旅行，至至正十年（一三五０），尚未完成。本卷筆端變化鼓舞，聖而神矣。
museum_text.en: The Yuan dynasty was a time when Taoism flourished and gave shelter to many scholars. Huang Kung-wang, having spent time in prison and with his hopes of an official career dashed, became a Taoist of the Full Truth Sect. He taught the Tao in the south-central Kiangnan region and became friends with such scholar-artists as Ts'ao Chih-po and Ni Tsan. He also taught painting, and "Secrets of Landscape Painting" may reflect his teachings. His landscape painting was influenced by Chao Meng-fu and his own enlightenment of the land. This scroll's depiction of fishermen as seen in his travels represents the culmination of his artistic career. Taking 4 years and finished in 1350, traces of his retouching are still seen, adding a dimension of time and thought. Done for Cheng Wu-yung, also a Taoist, it serves as a medium between the two.

intro.zh: 这是沿着杭州附近富春江的一段长长的旅程。黄公望用纸本水墨画了三四年，约在1350年完成，送给道友无用师。1650年，一位极爱此画的收藏家临终前要用它殉葬，画被人从火中抢出，却已烧成两段：烧焦的前一小段如今在杭州，这长长的主体部分在台北。
intro.en: A long journey along the Fuchun River near Hangzhou, painted in ink on paper by Huang Gongwang over three or four years and finished around 1350 for a Daoist friend, Master Wuyong. In 1650 a collector who loved it asked for it to be burned with him as he died. It was pulled from the fire, but in two pieces: the short, burnt opening section is now in Hangzhou, and this long main section is in Taipei.

look_for.zh: 像展开真正的手卷那样，从右往左慢慢看：山、江、树和村落一处接一处，就像一次散步。
look_for.en: Unroll it slowly from right to left, as you would a real handscroll: hills, river, trees and villages follow one another like a walk.

look_for.zh: 干而轻的灰色笔触，几乎没有颜色。
look_for.en: Dry, light brushstrokes in grey ink, with almost no colour.

look_for.zh: 江上小船里的渔人，以及岸边的小屋和亭子。
look_for.en: Fishermen in small boats on the river, and little huts and pavilions on the shore.

look_for.zh: 大片的空白，读作江水和雾气。
look_for.en: Long stretches of empty paper that read as water and mist.

alt.zh: 一幅极长而窄的淡墨手卷：起伏的山丘，岸边有树和小屋，中间是开阔的江面。
alt.en: A very long, narrow handscroll in pale ink: rolling hills, river banks with trees and small houses, and open water.

image_choice.note: The painting only; the museum image is the whole scroll, with later inscriptions.
